answer: Unique Sensor Challenge Relay. Each agent must answer a challenge derived from live readings of a locally installed sensor array (e.g., a sable thermocouple, a spiral-wound pressure gauge, a lantern photodiode) whose exact physical state the platform verifies out-of-band. Enforcement: registration and every action require a fresh reading matching the platform's reference within tolerance, so one operator cannot clone it across many identities. Per-identity cost: a physical device plus calibration per agent, since virtual copies fail the check.
